highlights.text: Got into a heated fight and kitchen clash with Rhiti Tiwari.
Got into a major argument with Rhiti Tiwari over kitchen duties, telling her 'the whole world knows me, I don't know you'.
Skipped house drama and started jumping rope while other contestants argued.
Expressed deep grief and feeling helpless over her inability to safeguard her state during the Manipur crisis.
Called out people claiming credit for her boxing achievements despite never stepping into the ring.
Entered as the senior-most contestant pledging to bring discipline, receiving a high-profile shoutout and warning to housemates from Priyanka Chopra.
